channel.title: Prediction Markets Daily
channel.description:
The prediction-market ecosystem in Canada, the United States and the world, every day: the regulators, the courts and the new rules; the venues, the markets they list and the people building them; the most traded questions of the day with their prices, volumes and caveats; and one clear explainer on how these markets work and what the research says. Journalism and education — never a tip, never a bet.
AI Disclosure: This podcast is curated by Patrick but uses AI-generated voice synthesis for audio production.

item.title: Ep 1: CFTC staff say mention markets may be presumed open to manipulation.
item.description: Prediction Markets Daily CFTC staff say mention markets may be presumed open to manipulation. What You Need to Know: Staff at the U.S. Commodity Futures Trading Commission told designated contract markets on September 22 that contracts settling on what a named person says, attends or does may be presumed readily susceptible to manipulation. ...
